card.checkedProcessesWhy: Only the processes this login can see were read, so a miner running as another user could be missed.
card.permissionHelp: How to give the check wider access is on the permission help screen, which is not built yet.

evidence.namesOnly: names only, no value is kept
evidence.gitMeaning: the whole repository, history included, can be downloaded
evidence.noFiles: Daminus kept no file names for this result.

means.sec_miner: A process that matches a known miner is running, or one runs from a file that was deleted. Treat the server as compromised.
means.sec_preload: A library is loaded into every program on the server. That is a common rootkit trick.
means.sec_upload_php: A PHP file where users upload images is a common sign of a web shell. Treat the site as possibly compromised.
means.sec_tmp_exec: Executable files in temp folders are where attackers often drop their tools. A build or a deploy script can leave some there too.
means.sec_ports: Anyone on the internet can try to reach this port. Databases are meant to listen on the server itself or a private network.
means.sec_recent_change: Expected if you deployed in the last days. Worth a look if you did not.
means.url_exposed: Anyone who asks gets this file. Only the key names are kept as proof; Daminus never stores a value.
means.url_tls: Browsers show a warning to every visitor, and some clients refuse to connect.
means.url_http: Visitors see an error or wait too long.

do.sec_miner: Find out what started it, stop and remove it, then change the passwords and keys the server holds.
do.sec_preload: Open /etc/ld.so.preload and check every library it lists. If you did not add them, treat the server as compromised.
do.sec_upload_php: Do not delete it yet. Copy it off the server for review, then check the access logs around {when}.
do.sec_tmp_exec: Check what each file is and who owns it. Remove what you did not put there.
do.sec_ports: Bind the service to 127.0.0.1 or a private address, or close the port in the firewall.
do.sec_recent_change: Compare with your last deploy. Look at the newest files first.
do.url_exposed: Point nginx root at public/, not the project folder. Then rotate every key listed, since anyone could have read them.
do.url_tls: Renew the certificate and reload the web server.
do.url_http: Open the site, then check the web server and the app logs on the host.
